title: Malicious code in glyphmatrix-fixture (npm)
description: The glyphmatrix-fixture npm package versions 1.0.0 and 1.0.1 contain malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different, secure computer. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate the malicious software, as the attacker may have gained full control of the system.
